title: Recoraled Reef
body: ### JOIN THE DISCORD https://discord.gg/hGPjw6s9yJ This is a **Minecraft 1.20.1 port** of Primetoxin's port of Nandonalt's mod. **LMK if there are any issues.** Anyways I'm out :p **Original Mod:** [CoralReef mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/coralreef) *Primetoxin's port was licensed under MIT, allowing this 1.20.1 port to be created.* This mod has growing coral, new coral and coral patches at shoreline
